purpose: Turn a real unroutable creation request into an evidence-bound detached capability proposal by searching a bounded exact-contract graph, preferring the shortest complete reusable project recipe, and optionally materializing and testing that hypothesis without admitting it.

properties.request: one exact creation request whose current live route and reusable input/output shape will be observed
properties.path: materialize-and-test only; detached candidate directory under creations/ or outside the machine body
properties.bridge_capability_id: optional exact caller selection from the analysis candidate list; never accepts an unobserved bridge
properties.replace: materialize-and-test only; optional explicit replacement of an existing detached candidate

contains: bounded exact-contract recipe paths, reuse decisions, and missing-link HOLD evidence
request-shaped disposable candidate test when materialized

relationships: begins only from an observed creation request and current live capability body
surfaces an existing detached capability candidate before compiling duplicate machinery
compiles one uniquely supported structural bridge into a detached experiment instead of silently adding a live route
searches supported template, exact executable-organ, interface-discovered organ, raw-project, and existing verified-composite producer paths to a requested verified-project goal
preserves missing organ interfaces, ambiguous minimum organ assemblies, incomplete explicit bindings, and discovery bounds as typed HOLD evidence
prefers a shorter already-live verified composite over rebuilding the same raw-project steps
optionally extends a verified-project path by persisting the exact verification object through the live JSON writer
projects file receipts through one closed file-digest-map binding rather than an arbitrary expression language
preserves ambiguity and unsupported semantics as typed HOLD states
uses the creation-unit forge for exact materialization and bounded testing
keeps proposal selection, semantic proof, admission, installation, merge, CANON, and permission change distinct

anatomy_refs.basis: The capability compiles one bounded interface-compatible route adapter and tests it independently before any admission choice.

Implemented recipes deterministically emit either an exact UTF-8 file-route alias or one bounded project recipe selected from observed request markers, preview evidence, exact live-manifest contracts, and shortest-complete-path evidence.
Supported proposals are passed to the existing detached creation-unit package builder rather than installed directly.

limitations: the first blueprint covers only missing exact UTF-8 file routes with exactly path and content inputs

the second blueprint covers only strict templates, exact executable-organ assemblies, uniquely resolved exact-interface organ goals, exact raw text-file projects, and their explicitly supported exact tested dependency versions
project recipe search is explicitly bounded to three steps
composite wiring is limited to the closed file-digest-map projection and exact whole-object bindings; arbitrary dataflow expressions are not executed
existing detached candidates are observed by exact handled request kind but are not automatically selected, admitted, or installed
matching an input/output shape is a structural hypothesis and does not prove semantic equivalence
a unique bridge selects only a detached experiment, not a live route or admission decision
the request-shaped fixture proves one exact example and not general format semantics

ambiguous bridges, paths, or minimum organ assemblies; missing organ interfaces or bindings; over-depth recipes; missing or ambiguous composite links; and unsupported gaps remain on HOLD unless a supported exact bridge or separately supplied design is provided
no operation installs, registers, admits, promotes, merges, changes CANON, or changes permissions
persistent_state: only caller-selected detached candidate packages persist; analysis and proposal operations are read-only

truth.basis: Observed route state, structural compatibility, semantic uncertainty, exact proposal lineage, fixture evidence, and HOLD reasons remain separate and inspectable.

agency.basis: Human or AI designs remain welcome, ambiguous choices are not hidden, and a compiled candidate grants itself no live-machine or admission authority.

continuity.basis: Experiments are materialized through the detached forge and do not replace or rewrite the continuing machine.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The compiler reuses the smallest compatible live primitive, tests an exact real request fixture, and holds rather than inventing unsupported semantics.
